facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: residual pressure found after isolation of TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on TX-3002 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 23 August 2007 a near hit was recorded on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
